2105-4742-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4742-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4742-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

719-2638-3000-3510.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-2638-3000-3510.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

728-1669-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
728-1669-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat
728-1669-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

252-4231-5394-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-6965.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2292-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1308-4365-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

301-2813-5663.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-5663.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1263-2301-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-527-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4365-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4365-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

147-3125-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-5231.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

659-4381-4613-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-5434.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

586-3967-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5226-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2440-4068-7082-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2440-4068-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3836-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3836-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

38-301-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
38-301-7096.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Skirk Prospector ability.
Repeat.

2292-3090-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

585-4508-5880-6291.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-2457-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5295-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

2921-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

618-2034-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

252-5394-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
252-5394-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

372-1090-4142.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-4142.notablePrerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Hostage Taker
372-1090-4142.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Hostage Taker to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Hostage Taker and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

56-789-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Gutter Grime and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-5256-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1657-2376.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Repeat from step 2.

876-4763-5553-6068.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

957-1809-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

1987-2556-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2556-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

413-2533-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Loyal Retainers enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the legendary creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3946-5448-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1339-4050-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4050-5572.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

2724-4006-5163.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Roon of the Hidden Realm. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

140-2871-4050-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 3 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-2871-4050-4258.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any creature.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {R}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1980-3014-4131-5261.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Emerald Charm without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Emerald Charm, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Emerald Charms, untapping Isochron Scepter and Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

628-1365-2034-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Dross Scorpion persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability, its undying ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its persist ability.
Repeat from step 4.

364-1309-1987-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
